content: The WikiDoc scholar program allows authors to monitor their contributions and, if necessary, reference their work. Below are the tools available for this purpose: 1. Total Edit Count: Authors can determine the total number of edits they have made by accessing the designated link. A visual guide is provided in the image below to assist with navigation. 2. Active Users List: A comprehensive list is available that displays the activity of users over the past 30 days. This list can be accessed via the provided link. 3. Recently Edited Pages: Authors can review a compilation of pages that have been edited recently. This list is accessible through the corresponding link.
